title: Rejection probability as a uniform failure rate
statement: For every positive natural number $m$, Boolean input $w$ of length $2m$, and Boolean proof of length $2m+1$, the rejection probability of the inner product verifier equals the fraction of its seeds for which the corresponding check fails. Its seeds are either a choice of one of the two endpoint checks, or a coordinate $i<m$ together with a choice between checking the product at coordinate $i$ and checking the prefix-sum recurrence there.
hypotheses_covered: the input is a Boolean word of length $2m$
the proof is a Boolean word of length $2m+1$
